generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Chemistry laboratory (化学实验室). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Photograph a bright teaching chemistry laboratory from slightly above bench height, looking diagonally toward one switched-off fume cupboard in the upper third. Place the ring stand with its burette clamp inside the cupboard without any active reaction. On the broad foreground bench, isolate one conical flask, beaker, graduated cylinder and wash bottle in a gentle left-to-right rhythm; set the goggles beside them. Centre the hotplate stirrer with no glowing surface and place the spill tray at the lower right. A laboratory instructor may stand in the background wearing a plain coat, not touching the targets. Use crisp neutral light and realistic transparent glass reflections. No smoke, flames, splashes, dangerous mixing, coloured labels, equations, readable screens or duplicate vessels.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: conical Erlenmeyer flask, borosilicate beaker, laboratory fume cupboard, chemical splash goggles, laboratory ring stand, burette clamp, digital hotplate stirrer, laboratory wash bottle, graduated measuring cylinder, chemical spill tray.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
